title: Harry Potter Filming Locations: Family Days Out in the UK
description: Visit real Harry Potter filming locations with the family: Alnwick Castle, the Glenfinnan Viaduct and Jacobite steam train, King’s Cross and more around the UK.
h1: Harry Potter filming locations for family days out
intro: Beyond the Studio Tour, you can stand where Harry learned to fly and watch the “Hogwarts Express” cross a Highland viaduct. Here are the UK filming locations families love.

image.alt: A stone castle under white clouds

cardText: Alnwick Castle, the Glenfinnan Viaduct, King’s Cross and more.

blocks.title: Scout’s location tip
blocks.text: Pair a big ticket with a free one. Watching the Jacobite cross the Glenfinnan Viaduct is free, and so is a photo at Platform 9¾.
points: Alnwick Castle runs broomstick training sessions
The Jacobite runs seasonally: book early
Check opening seasons before travelling far

sections.html: Alnwick Castle was used for Hogwarts exteriors in the first two films. Its outer bailey is where Harry’s first flying lesson was filmed, and families can join broomstick training there today. alnwickcastle.com

sections.h2: Glenfinnan Viaduct and the Jacobite, Scotland
sections.html: The curving Glenfinnan Viaduct appears in several films. The Jacobite steam train runs between Fort William and Mallaig on a seasonal timetable and sells out early. Watching it cross from the viewpoints near the Glenfinnan visitor centre is free. Read more in our steam train days out guide.
A luggage trolley vanishes into the wall at Platform 9¾, next to a themed shop. Photos with your own camera are free. Go early to beat the queue.
Gloucester Cathedral’s cloisters were used for Hogwarts corridors in several films. It’s a working cathedral, so check visiting times and any charges before you go.
Finish with the Warner Bros. Studio Tour London, where you can walk through the actual sets. See all our Harry Potter days out.

faqs.q: Which castle was Hogwarts in Harry Potter?
faqs.a: Alnwick Castle in Northumberland was used for Hogwarts exteriors in the first two films. Other locations, such as Gloucester Cathedral, were used for interiors.

faqs.q: Can you watch the Hogwarts Express for free?
faqs.a: Yes. You can watch the Jacobite steam train cross the Glenfinnan Viaduct from public viewpoints when it runs. Check the seasonal timetable first.
